limitations_and_boundaries: The analysis focuses on long-range problems; short-range tasks are not the focus.
The FA layer solution is simple and may not be optimal; better solutions may exist.
Theoretical lower bounds are combinatorial and may not be tight for gradient-based learning.
Experiments are limited to specific GNN variants and datasets.

Synthetic NEIGHBORSMATCH benchmark to control problem radius and demonstrate over-squashing.
Theoretical analysis of information flow in GNNs, identifying a bottleneck when aggregating messages across long paths.

methods.protocol_description: Replace the last GNN layer with a fully adjacent layer, connecting all nodes to allow direct interaction, reducing over-squashing.
